items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: see Caroline was conducting, and we -- I played (finger snapping) Ben Hur in that theater.

ctx.x: And he's a toot, toot, toot, would change the color, I mean change the light. One -- mash of his foot would make it red, green, blue, whichever you want. So we were kind of -- and this band was riding us. Okay, get in here, God bless you. Get in here on time, because you're holding up the show. You know? And say okay, so all right, let's hit it. One, we're late.

And Caroline (Thank you) had the band, because I'll come back to her. She -- bass would come in, he'd come in, because he's got to sit this rigging up there, you know, get this foot set, and plug in the lights (Laughs) this particular time he -- we started to hit the overture, and he say (whack) prrsst, the thing lit him up. There was a short in the wire
